description: Client-side JavaScript code for UI interactions in an OpenCart project, including tooltips, observe, button states, form submissions via AJAX, file uploads, autocomplete, product view toggles, and modal handling.

methods.name: oc_tooltip
methods.description: Initializes and shows Bootstrap tooltip on hover.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Sets up a MutationObserver to watch DOM changes.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Changes button or link appearance and disabled state for loading/reset.

methods.name: submit form handler
methods.description: Handles AJAX form submission, including validation feedback and redirection.

methods.name: upload button handler
methods.description: Handles file upload via AJAX with size validation.

methods.name: product view toggle handlers
methods.description: Switches between list and grid views, storing preference in localStorage.

methods.name: modal link handler
methods.description: Loads and displays modal content via AJAX.
